name: Xperia 5

images.credit: Puddin1975, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia XZ2 Compact, Sony Xperia XZ3

Body.Dimensions: 158 mm H, 68 mm W, 8.2 mm D
Body.Other: IP65/68, DualShock support, Smart Connectivity Switch

Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x 2.84 GHz Gold Prime, 3x 2.42 GHz Gold, 4x 1.8 GHz Silver) Kryo 485

Memory.Storage: Universal Flash Storage (UFS), 64 GB (SO-01M, SOV41 and 901SO models), 128 GB (J8210, J8270, J9210 and J9260 models)

Display.Display: 6.1 in 1080p (2520 x 1080) HDR OLED, ~449 pixel density, Gorilla Glass 6, 8-bit (16M colors)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.2 MP (Sony IMX563), f/1.6, 26mm (wide), 1/2.6", 1.4 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K3M3), f/2.4, 52mm (telephoto), 1/3.4", 1.0 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 2x optical zoom, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K3M3), f/2.4, 16mm (ultra-wide), 1/3.4", 1.0 μm
Cameras.Front camera: 8 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K4H7), f/2.0, 24mm (wide), 1/4", 1.0 μm, 1080p@30fps (5-axis gyro-EIS)

Battery.Battery: Non-removable Li-ion 3140 mAh, rated capacity: 3000 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2.4/5GHz), Bluetooth 5.0, USB-C, NFC, GPS with Assisted GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, 1seg (SO-01M, SOV41 and 901SO models only), Mobile FeliCa/Osaifu-Keitai (J9260, SO-01M, SOV41 and 901SO models only)
